# v0.5.0b4 — Fix app setup rejected by an optional current reading

This beta fixes setup failing with **The app responds, but its data is not
accepted** and `invalid service snapshot (identity.max_evse_current)` in the
Home Assistant log.

The optional maximum-EVSE-current capability previously blocked the entire
connection when its numeric value was outside 6–32 A. Such readings are now
treated as an unknown capability. Their raw measurement remains available for
diagnosis, while the configured app and Home Assistant current caps continue
to constrain charging commands. Invalid payload types and non-finite values
are still rejected. Setup sends no charging commands.

## Update

1. Update the integration to **0.5.0b4** through the Marketplace/HACS beta channel
   and restart Home Assistant Core.
2. Confirm the discovered app again. The integration also accepts the affected
   reading from the already-running **0.5.0b3** app, so setup does not depend on
   restarting the Modbus service first. URL and token are supplied automatically.
3. Use **Check for updates** in the Supervisor app store and update
   **Mennekes Amtron Modbus Service** to **0.5.0b4** from `#apps-beta` to keep both
   components aligned. Updating the app itself briefly interrupts its heartbeat.

Minimum HA 2026.9.0 and latest stable HA 2026.11.0 validation passed, including
raw-register-to-HTTP regressions for the rejected readings, command-limit checks,
strict typing and coverage above 99%. Physical verification of the corrected
setup remains pending. **v0.4.1 remains the stable release.**
